Stories

There is no better way of expanding horizons than to travel. To live like locals, to experience diverse cultures, and to wander into the wilderness. After all, we are merely a collection of memories, so to explore the world is to enrich ourselves. With this in mind, I hope to embark on a global journey to learn about our world, the life which inhabits it, and to find myself in the process.

About

David Chui

Father, Husband, Veteran, Engineer.

Curious mind always seeking my next adventure. Currently a Software Engineer at Spectrum.

I was born in Xi’an China, raised in Montreal Canada, went to High School in Texas, and graduated from University of Colorado at Denver with a B.S. in Finance and Information Systems. I served in the USAF as a structural engineer at Nellis AFB in Las Vegas, where I met my wife. Home base for us is now the front range of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado, where we are raising our child to be a little mountain man.
